Because the terrace burn is recorded at the bridge settlement, the vault audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 94% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 398 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
